messages.task:
You are a financial analysis assistant working with a virtual data room that mirrors a real‐world disclosure.

Scenario
The company operates several risk-sharing and protection programs.  In 2012 it guaranteed accelerated distributions in a commodities broker bankruptcy, set up a Family Farmer and Rancher Protection Fund with specific per-participant limits, and recorded related liabilities.  Redeemable non-controlling interests are presented in the statements of equity and the narrative discloses changes such as contributions, distributions, stock-based compensation, comprehensive income, and the year-end balance.  Your task concerns the year-end balance of those redeemable non-controlling interests.

Tools at your disposal
• get_company_id(company_name): return the internal identifier of a company whose name matches the argument (case-insensitive).
• get_line_item_id(line_item_name): return the identifier of a particular financial statement line item.
• get_financial_amount(company_id, line_item_id, year): return the numeric amount (in millions of USD) recorded for that company / item / year.
• calculate_percentage_change(old_value, new_value): compute the % change from old_value to new_value.
• list_company_names(): list all company names present in the database.
• list_line_items(): list all line-item names present in the database.

Question
What is the percentage change in the balance of non-controlling interests from 2010 to 2011?

Instructions
Plan your reasoning, call whatever tools you need (in any order), and return the final numeric answer formatted with one decimal place followed by a percent sign (e.g. "3.2%").
